# game-protocol

> Deterministic game-data protocol: two-layer documents (machine-verifiable +
> human-judgeable) for game data, sibling of CCDD/taskmd/ccdd-gate in the KDD
> family. This page publishes the protocol's own spec as searchable skills.

## Docs

- [Spec](/SPEC.md)
- [Repository](https://github.com/MauricioPerera/game-protocol)

## Start here (agents, read this first)

To build a game with this protocol, **generate a fresh document — do not copy an example**:
`node tools/game-new.js <profile> mi-juego.GAME.md` writes a clean skeleton that lints at
zero errors. Then loop: edit → `node tools/game-lint.js mi-juego.GAME.md --agent` → apply
each `hint` → repeat until `errors: 0` → `node tools/game-export.js`.

Everything under `examples/` is a **finished demo game** that exercises the protocol, not a
project template and not part of your project. Those files are deletable. Read them only to
see what shape a token takes; never inherit their content (species, tiles, maps) into a new
game. `manifest.json` is the canonical machine-readable list of profiles, tokens and rules.
